title: Data Architect
employmentType:
### Job Title: Data Architect

#### Company Name: R Systems

#### Roles and Responsibilities:

1. **Architectural Design & Development**:
- Design and implement robust data architectures that meet the business requirements, ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance.
- Utilize specialized tools and frameworks, including AWS, Redshift, Glue, and Data Vault, to establish architecture that supports ETL processes and data governance.

2. **Data Pipeline Development**:
- Create and maintain ETL and data pipeline processes to ingest and transform data efficiently using AWS technologies such as Glue and Lambda.
- Leverage Amazon Kinesis to build real-time data processing applications, ensuring seamless data flow and immediate access to insights.

3. **Big Data Management**:
- Implement and manage data solutions using Amazon EMR to process large datasets and ensure timely retrieval of data for analytics and reporting.
- Optimize data storage and retrieval mechanisms in AWS Redshift to support analytical workloads and maintain high performance.

4. **Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement**:
- Work closely with data engineers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into effective data architecture solutions.
- Act as a point of contact for data governance, ensuring adherence to best practices and compliance standards.

5. **Documentation & Best Practices**:
- Maintain comprehensive documentation of data architectures, workflows, and processes to facilitate knowledge sharing and compliance.
- Establish and promote best practices related to data management and architecture within the organization.

6. **Performance Optimization & Troubleshooting**:
- Monitor data pipelines and architecture performance, making adjustments as necessary to optimize resource utilization and improve efficiency.
- Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to data flows, ensuring minimal disruption to business operations.

7. **Continuous Learning & Innovation**:
- Stay updated with emerging trends and technologies in data architecture, DevOps, and cloud services, continuously seeking opportunities to enhance existing systems and processes.
- Advocate for the adoption of new tools and methodologies that can advance the organization's data capabilities.

#### Desired Set of Skills:
- Proficient in **DevOps** practices and tools to automate deployment and management of data architecture.
- Hands-on experience with **Kinesis** and **EMR** for real-time data processing and big data solutions.

#### Required Set of Skills:
- Expertise in leading data architecture initiatives and in-depth knowledge of AWS services including **Redshift**, **Glue**, and **Lambda**.
- Strong understanding of **Data Vault** methodology, **ETL** processes, and **Data Governance** frameworks.

#### Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
- Proven experience as a Data Architect with a strong portfolio of implementing successful data architectures in cloud environments.

---

Candidates with a combination of the above skills and a passion for innovative data solutions are encouraged to apply. Join R Systems and contribute to transforming how we leverage data for strategic insights!

employmentType:
Job Title
Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM – Technical Lead

Role Summary
We are seeking an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM Technical Lead to lead the design, development, and delivery of Dynamics 365 solutions across Sales, Customer Service, Marketing, and Power Platform. The Technical Lead will be responsible for technical architecture, solution quality, performance, security, and guiding development teams while collaborating closely with business stakeholders and functional consultants.

Key Responsibilities
Technical Leadership & Architecture

Lead the end‑to‑end technical design and implementation of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions
Define solution architecture aligned with business needs, Microsoft best practices, and performance standards
Own technical decisions for:

Customizations
Extensions
Integrations


Ensure scalable, secure, and maintainable CRM implementations


Dynamics 365 Development & Customization

Lead and review development activities including:

Plugins and custom workflows
JavaScript and form scripting
Custom APIs and extensions


Configure and customize:

Entities, forms, views, and dashboards
Business rules and security roles


Ensure code quality, performance optimization, and error handling


Power Platform Leadership

Architect and guide solutions using:

Power Automate (flows, automation)
Power Apps (model‑driven and canvas apps)


Lead implementation of low‑code/no‑code solutions with proper governance
Enforce Power Platform best practices and ALM standards


Integrations & Data Management

Design and lead integrations between Dynamics 365 and:

ERP systems
Third‑party applications
Azure services


Define data migration and synchronization strategies
Ensure data integrity, security, and performance across systems


DevOps, ALM & Release Management

Define and enforce CRM ALM and DevOps processes:

Source control
Build and release pipelines
Environment strategy


Support CI/CD using Azure DevOps or similar tools
Oversee deployments, upgrades, and version management


Security, Compliance & Governance

Design role‑based security models and access controls
Ensure compliance with data protection regulations (GDPR, audit requirements)
Define governance standards for customization and extensibility


Team Leadership & Mentorship

Lead and mentor CRM developers and technical teams
Conduct code reviews and technical design reviews
Provide technical guidance, coaching, and knowledge sharing
Collaborate with architects, BAs, functional consultants, and project managers


Stakeholder Collaboration

Work closely with business and functional leads to understand requirements
Translate functional designs into technical solutions
Participate in technical workshops, design sessions, and executive reviews


Required Skills & Qualifications
Core Technical Skills

Strong hands‑on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM platform
Proven expertise in:

Plugins, workflows, and custom development
JavaScript, C#, .NET


Deep understanding of:

Dynamics 365 entity model
Security architecture
Performance optimization


Power Platform & Azure

Strong experience with Power Automate and Power Apps
Knowledge of Azure services such as:

Azure Functions
Azure Logic Apps
Azure Service Bus


Experience with integration patterns and APIs


Development & ALM Tools

Experience with:

Azure DevOps
Git / source control
CI/CD pipelines


Understanding of environment strategy (Dev, Test, UAT, Prod)


Soft & Leadership Skills

Strong problem‑solving and decision‑making abilities
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
Ability to lead teams and drive technical excellence
Experience working in Agile / Scrum environments
